theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ⨆ j, μs j K < ∞) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 c)
